qualification_domain.scope: Explicit archived 2D and current 3D coupled-vector observations under configured public calendar/key, Helper off, named physical fields, payloads and operating points. This is a finite engineering requirement audit; cells are not independent environmental samples.
excluded_strata: Unknown waveform epochs and ordinals; unqualified Helper spectrum
General hardware/device capacity and sensitivity claims
Environmental occurrence probabilities and all-GUI operating qualification
required_missing_strata: Calibrated broadband complex-channel observations from independent disturbed events
Multiple-hop propagation with reflecting boundaries and jointly coupled irregularities
Rapid intrinsic plasma evolution beyond prescribed slow rigid translation
Independent random 3D field ensembles and broader joint hardware/interference/acquisition conditions
Predeclared operational delivery anchors with stated operating requirements; sensitivity observations are characterization, not guaranteed-success points
